name: company-accounting-software
description: Company Accounting Software (CAS) — React + Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix server run prepare:deploy && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix server run migrate:deploy && npm --prefix server run start
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
